experiments.title: Healing Helping Hands: evidence atlas
experiments.description: TLDR: C3 tests Qwen 0.6B plus Jev against paired Qwen-only and Jev-only controls, first on 60 fresh qualification cases, then in 270 evidence-atlas worlds with 200 curators each. Compare repair during withdrawals, false notices and outages with verified central controls. Measure extraction accuracy, correction, anchoring, query error, retention and cost. Worker-local supervision replaces the failed laptop tunnel; original budget and C1/C2 failures are preserved. Synthetic repeated templates and three corpora limit generalization. Prior composite and Jev-only both scored 60/60: no incremental Qwen benefit established.

experiments.title: Swarm of Theseus — SOC-24
experiments.description: TLDR: Can useful culture survive complete member replacement? Compare notes, mentoring, both and neither with founders and a verbatim procedure ceiling in seed-bank, observatory and repair-dock worlds. Measure unseen-case accuracy, arbitrary convention retention, turnover and onboarding cost. Small exploratory single-model study of seeded procedures; not spontaneous culture or confirmatory evidence.
